sk.v: Nie (Tamina verzia používa vanilkový extrakt bez alkoholu).

en.t: 340 g unsalted butter
170 g finely chopped dark chocolate, about 72%
450 g granulated sugar
55 g light brown sugar (packed)
1 3/4 tsp (4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use about half as much by volume or the same weight

15 g vanilla extract (about 1 tbsp (15 ml))
1 tsp (5 ml) instant espresso powder, such as Medaglia d’Oro (optional)
125 g all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal (spooned)
115 g Dutch-process cocoa powder, such as Cacao Barry Extra Brute (spooned)

55 g svetlý hnedý cukor

15 g vanilkový extrakt (asi 1 PL, 15 ml)
1 ČL (5 ml) instantná káva espresso (nepovinné)

en.t: 1. Getting Ready: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Line a 23 × 33 × 5 cm anodized aluminum baking pan with foil to cover the bottom and long sides of the pan. (It's all right to leave the short sides exposed.) If you like, grease lightly with pan spray.

2. In a 2840 ml stainless steel saucier, melt butter over medium-low heat. When it has completely melted, increase heat to medium and simmer, stirring with a heat-resistant spatula while butter hisses and pops. Continue cooking and stirring, scraping up any brown bits that form inside the pan, until butter is golden yellow and perfectly silent. Remove from heat and stir in dark chocolate; the mixture will seem quite thin.

3. Making the Batter: Combine granulated sugar, brown sugar, salt, eggs, vanilla, and instant espresso (if using) in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment. Whip on medium-high until extremely thick and fluffy, about 8 minutes. (The whipping time can vary significantly depending on bowl size, batter temperature, and mixer wattage, so use the visual cues as your primary guide.)

4. Meanwhile, sift together flour and cocoa powder. When the foamed eggs are fluffy and thick, reduce speed to low and pour in the warm chocolate-butter. Once it is incorporated, add cocoa-flour mixture all at once and continue mixing until roughly combined. Finish with a flexible spatula, scraping and folding to ensure batter is well mixed from the bottom up.

5. Pour into prepared pan and bake until brownies are glossy and just barely firm, about 30 minutes, or to an internal temperature of 96 °C. (Take care that the probe is inserted at a sharp angle to avoid touching the bottom of the pan.) The timing of this recipe is based on anodized aluminum and will vary significantly with glass, ceramic, or nonstick pans, materials that will also affect the brownies' consistency.

6. Cool brownies to room temperature to allow their crumb to set before slicing. Slide a butter knife between the brownies and the short ends of the pan; gently tug on the foil, then lift to remove the brownies from the pan. Cut into 24 6 cm squares and store in an airtight container with a sheet of wax paper between layers, about 1 week at room temperature.

sk.t: 1. Príprava: Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Formu 23 × 33 × 5 cm vystelieme alobalom tak, aby zakrýval dno a dlhé strany (kratšie strany môžu zostať odkryté). Podľa chuti ju zľahka postriekame tukom na formy.

2. V nerezovom hrnci s objemom 2840 ml roztopíme maslo na miernom ohni. Keď sa úplne roztopí, zvýšime oheň na stredný a maslo za stáleho miešania žiaruvzdornou stierkou povaríme. Maslo bude syčať a praskať. Varíme a miešame ďalej a zoškrabujeme hnedé kúsky, ktoré sa vytvoria na dne, kým maslo nie je zlatožlté a úplne neutíchne. Odstavíme z ohňa a vmiešame horkú čokoládu. Zmes bude pomerne riedka.

3. Cesto: Do misy kuchynského robota so šľahacou metlou dáme kryštálový cukor, hnedý cukor, soľ, vajcia, vanilku a instantné espresso (ak ho používame). Šľaháme na vyššom strednom stupni, kým zmes nie je veľmi hustá a nadýchaná, asi 8 minút. Čas šľahania sa môže výrazne líšiť podľa veľkosti misy, teploty zmesi a výkonu robota, preto sa riadime najmä vzhľadom.

4. Medzitým spolu preosejeme múku a kakao. Keď je vaječná pena nadýchaná a hustá, znížime rýchlosť na najnižší stupeň a vlejeme teplú čokoládovo-maslovú zmes. Keď sa spojí, naraz pridáme kakao s múkou a miešame, kým sa suroviny zhruba nespoja. Nakoniec cesto premiešame ohybnou stierkou, zoškrabeme ho zo stien a dna misy a zľahka ho premiešame odspodu nahor.

5. Cesto vylejeme do pripravenej formy a pečieme, kým brownies nie sú lesklé a na povrchu sotva pevné, asi 30 minút, alebo kým vnútri nedosiahnu 96 °C. Teplomer zapichneme šikmo, aby sa nedotýkal dna formy. Čas pečenia platí pre eloxovanú hliníkovú formu. V sklenenej, keramickej alebo nepriľnavej forme sa výrazne líši a zmení sa aj konzistencia brownies.

6. Brownies necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, aby sa stredy pred krájaním ustálili. Medzi brownies a kratšie strany formy prejdeme nožom na maslo, jemne potiahneme za alobal a brownies vyberieme z formy. Nakrájame na 24 štvorcov so stranou asi 6 cm. Skladujeme v uzatvárateľnej nádobe, vrstvy prekladáme papierom, pri izbovej teplote asi 1 týždeň.

src: King Arthur Baking — King Arthur Test Kitchen — "Blondies"

en.v: Store any leftovers, well wrapped, at room temperature for up to a week; freeze for longer storage.

sk.v: Zvyšky uchovávame dobre zabalené pri izbovej teplote až týždeň; na dlhšie skladovanie ich zmrazíme.

en.t: 8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted
426 g light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, packed
3/4 tsp (4.5 g) table salt
3 large eggs (≈150 g without shell), cold from the refrigerator
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
180 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 tsp (4 g) baking powder
168 g chopped pecans or walnuts, divided
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Lightly grease a 23 cm x 33 cm pan.
2. In a medium heatproof bowl, combine the butter with the brown sugar and salt.

3. Heat in the microwave at high power for 90 seconds to 2 minutes, or heat over medium on the stovetop, until the butter is completely melted. Remove from the microwave/heat and stir until evenly combined; the mixture will look like wet sand.
4. Beat in the cold eggs, one at a time, mixing until each egg is absorbed before adding the next. Stir in the vanilla.
5. Combine the flour and baking powder and add to the sugar mixture. Stir until the batter is smooth; scrape the bowl to make sure all the flour is incorporated and no dry streaks remain.
6. Stir in 113 g of the nuts.
7. Scoop the batter into the prepared pan, spreading it evenly with a spatula dipped in cold water or your wet fingers. Sprinkle the remaining nuts on top.

8. Bake the blondies for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top crust is shiny but the middle is still gooey (though not liquid). A toothpick or paring knife inserted into the center should come out with a few wet crumbs attached, but no raw batter showing.
9. Remove the blondies from the oven; cool completely before slicing and serving.
10. Storage information: Store any leftovers, well wrapped, at room temperature for up to a week; freeze for longer storage.

1. Rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Formu 23 × 33 cm zľahka vymastíme.
2. V stredne veľkej žiaruvzdornej mise zmiešame maslo s hnedým cukrom a soľou.

3. Zohrievame v mikrovlnke na plný výkon 90 sekúnd až 2 minúty alebo na sporáku na strednom ohni, kým sa maslo úplne neroztopí. Vyberieme z mikrovlnky alebo odstavíme z ohňa a miešame, kým sa zmes rovnomerne nespojí; bude vyzerať ako mokrý piesok.
4. Po jednom zašľaháme studené vajcia; každé vmiešame, kým sa nevstrebe, a až potom pridáme ďalšie. Vmiešame vanilku.
5. Zmiešame múku s kypriacim práškom a pridáme k cukrovej zmesi. Miešame, kým cesto nie je hladké; misu vyškrabeme, aby sa zapracovala všetka múka a nezostali suché pásy.
6. Vmiešame 113 g orechov.
7. Cesto preložíme do pripravenej formy a rozotrieme ho stierkou namočenou v studenej vode alebo mokrými prstami. Navrch posypeme zvyšnými orechmi.

8. Blondies pečieme 30 až 35 minút, kým vrchná kôrka nie je lesklá, ale stred je ešte mazľavý (nie však tekutý). Špáradlo alebo nožík zapichnutý do stredu má vyjsť s niekoľkými vlhkými omrvinkami, ale bez surového cesta.
9. Blondies vyberieme z rúry; pred krájaním a podávaním ich necháme úplne vychladnúť.
10. Skladovanie: zvyšky dobre zabalené uchovávame pri izbovej teplote najviac týždeň; na dlhšie skladovanie ich zmrazíme.

en.v: 23 cm springform pan, parchment paper, medium saucepan, stand mixer, wire rack, fine-mesh sieve

sk.v: Tortová forma s odnímateľným okrajom 23 cm, papier na pečenie, stredná rajnica, stojanový mixér, mriežka, jemné sitko

en.v: Once cooled, the cake can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days or refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 1 week. The cake can be tightly wrapped in plastic and frozen for up to 1 month. To thaw, let sit in refrigerator overnight.

sk.v: Vychladnutý koláč môžeme uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe pri izbovej teplote až 3 dni alebo v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 1 týždeň. Koláč môžeme pevne zabaliť do fólie a zmraziť až na 1 mesiac. Rozmrazujeme cez noc v chladničke.

en.t: Baking spray with flour
113 g bittersweet chocolate, 60% cacao, finely chopped
113 g unsalted butter (8 tbsp), cubed
1 tsp (5 ml) fine instant espresso powder, such as Delallo
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
46 g unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted, plus more for dusting
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract
3 large eggs (about 150 g), at room temperature
150 g granulated sugar
Sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, for serving (optional)

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Using baking spray, coat the interior of a 23 cm springform pan; line bottom of pan with a parchment paper round and the sides with a separate parchment strip; set aside.

2. Fill a medium saucepan with water to a depth of 2.5 cm and bring to a boil over medium-high; reduce heat to a simmer over medium-low. In a medium-size heatproof bowl, combine chocolate, butter, espresso powder, and salt, and place over saucepan of simmering water. Cook, stirring frequently, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat, being careful not to drip any water into the melted chocolate. Whisk in cocoa powder and vanilla extract until combined and smooth; set aside.

3. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine eggs and sugar. Whisk on medium-high speed until mixture is pale, falls off the whisk attachment in thick ribbons (they should slowly sink back into the batter) and has increased by about 1/3 in volume, 5 to 7 minutes. (Alternatively, an electric hand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment can be used to whip the eggs and sugar.) Using a flexible spatula, fold chocolate mixture into eggs gradually until just combined and no streaks remain. Gently scrape chocolate batter into prepared pan, using a small offset spatula to evenly spread and smooth the top if necessary.

4. Bake until top is dry and a wooden toothpick inserted near center of cake comes out with a few moist crumbs, about 25 minutes. Let cool in pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes. Run a small offset spatula or butter knife around edges of cake to loosen, if necessary; remove pan sides, and discard strips of parchment. Let cake cool completely on pan base on wire rack, about 1 1/2 hours. Using a large offset spatula, gently loosen cake from pan base and carefully transfer cake to a plate, removing and discarding parchment round. Using a fine-mesh sieve, dust cake with additional cocoa powder. Serve with sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired.

Cook, stirring frequently, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 5 to 6 minutes. Remove from heat, being careful not to drip any water into the melted chocolate. Whisk in cocoa powder and vanilla extract until combined and smooth; set aside.

3. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, combine eggs and sugar. Whisk on medium-high speed until mixture is pale, falls off the whisk attachment in thick ribbons (they should slowly sink back into the batter) and has increased by about 1/3 in volume, 5 to 7 minutes. (Alternatively, an electric hand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment can be used to whip the eggs and sugar.) Using a flexible spatula, fold chocolate mixture into eggs gradually until just combined and no streaks remain. Gently scrape chocolate batter into prepared pan, using a small offset spatula to evenly spread and smooth the top if necessary.

4. Bake until top is dry and a wooden toothpick inserted near center of cake comes out with a few moist crumbs, about 25 minutes. Let cool in pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes. Run a small offset spatula or butter knife around edges of cake to loosen, if necessary; remove pan sides, and discard strips of parchment. Let cake cool completely on pan base on wire rack, about 1 1/2 hours. Using a large offset spatula, gently loosen cake from pan base and carefully transfer cake to a plate, removing and discarding parchment round. Using a fine-mesh sieve, dust cake with additional cocoa powder. Serve with sweetened whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired.

1. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Vnútro tortovej formy s odnímateľným okrajom s priemerom 23 cm vystriekame sprejom na pečenie; dno vystelieme kruhom z papiera na pečenie a okraj samostatným pásom papiera; dáme bokom.

2. Stredne veľký hrniec naplníme vodou do výšky 2,5 cm a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do varu; stlmíme na mierny až stredný oheň, aby voda len mierne vrela. V stredne veľkej žiaruvzdornej mise zmiešame čokoládu, maslo, instantné espresso a soľ a misu položíme na hrniec s mierne vriacou vodou. Za častého miešania zohrievame, kým sa čokoládová zmes neroztopí a nie je hladká, 5 až 6 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a dávame pozor, aby do roztopenej čokolády nekvaplo ani trochu vody. Vyšľaháme s kakaom a vanilkovým extraktom dohladka; dáme bokom.

3. V mise stojanového mixéra s nadstavcom na šľahanie zmiešame vajcia s cukrom. Šľaháme na stredne vysokých až vysokých otáčkach, kým zmes nie je svetlá, nepadá zo šľahača v hustých stuhách (tie by mali pomaly klesať späť do cesta) a nezväčší objem asi o tretinu, 5 až 7 minút. (Vajcia s cukrom môžeme vyšľahať aj ručným elektrickým šľahačom.) Pružnou stierkou postupne vmiešame do vajec čokoládovú zmes, len kým sa nespojí a nezostanú pásy. Čokoládové cesto jemne preložíme do pripravenej formy a ak treba, vrch rozotrieme a uhladíme malou zahnutou stierkou.

4. Pečieme, kým vrch nie je suchý a drevené špáradlo zapichnuté blízko stredu nevyjde s niekoľkými vlhkými omrvinkami, asi 25 minút. Necháme 30 minút chladnúť vo forme na mriežke. Ak treba, okraje uvoľníme malou zahnutou stierkou alebo nožom na maslo; odstránime okraj formy a pásy papiera vyhodíme. Necháme úplne vychladnúť na dne formy na mriežke, asi 1½ hodiny. Veľkou zahnutou stierkou koláč jemne uvoľníme od dna a opatrne preložíme na tanier; papierový kruh odstránime a vyhodíme. Cez jemné sitko koláč poprášime ďalším kakaom. Ak chceme, podávame s osladenou šľahačkou alebo vanilkovou zmrzlinou.

en.t: 248 g all-purpose flour

14 tbsp (195 g) unsalted butter, divided

213 g bittersweet chocolate chips
4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter, cut into 4 pieces

1 tbsp (15 ml) instant espresso powder

248 g all-purpose flour

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Make foil sling for 33 × 23 cm baking pan by folding 2 long sheets of aluminum foil; first sheet should be 33 cm wide and second sheet should be 23 cm wide. Lay sheets of foil in pan perpendicular to each other, with extra foil hanging over edges of pan. Push foil into corners and up sides of pan, smoothing foil flush to pan. Spray foil with vegetable oil spray.
2. **FOR THE COOKIE DOUGH:**

3. Whisk flour and baking soda together in large bowl; set aside. Heat 10 tbsp (140 g) butter in 25 cm skillet over medium-high heat until melted, about 2 minutes. Continue to cook, swirling skillet and stirring constantly with silicone spatula, until butter is dark golden brown and has nutty aroma, 1 to 3 minutes longer. Remove skillet from heat and transfer browned butter to second large bowl. Stir remaining 4 tbsp (56 g) butter into hot butter until completely melted.

4. Add brown sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla, and salt to bowl with butter and whisk until no lumps of sugar remain. Add egg and yolk and whisk until smooth. Let mixture stand for 3 minutes, then whisk until mixture is thick and shiny, about 1 minute. Using silicone spatula or wooden spoon, stir in flour mixture until just combined. Fold in chocolate chips until evenly distributed and no dry flour remains.
5. **FOR THE BROWNIE BATTER:**

6. Combine butter, chocolate, cocoa, espresso powder, and salt in now-empty large bowl. Add boiling water and whisk until butter and chocolate are completely melted, about 1 minute. Add sugar, oil, eggs and yolks, and vanilla and whisk until smooth. Gently whisk in flour until just incorporated. Transfer batter to prepared pan.

7. Using #40 cookie scoop or heaping tbsp measure, dollop mounds of cookie dough evenly over brownie batter (cookie dough can touch edges of pan), about 24 portions. Bake until toothpick inserted into cookie layer comes out clean, 40 to 45 minutes, rotating pan halfway through baking. Transfer pan to wire rack and let cool for 1 hour.

8. Using foil overhang, lift brookies out of pan; return to wire rack and let cool completely, 1 to 1½ hours. Cut brookies into 24 pieces and sprinkle with flake sea salt, if using. Serve. (Brookies can be stored at room temperature for up to 4 days or frozen for up to 1 month.)

1. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Na formu 33 × 23 cm pripravíme alobalový „popruh": preložíme 2 dlhé pásy alobalu; prvý má mať šírku 33 cm a druhý 23 cm. Pásy položíme do formy krížom cez seba tak, aby alobal presahoval cez okraje. Alobal vtlačíme do rohov a na steny formy a uhladíme ho. Alobal vystriekame rastlinným olejom v spreji.
2. **NA KEKSOVÉ CESTO:**

3. Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme múku s jedlou sódou; dáme bokom. V panvici s priemerom 25 cm rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 8½ PL (120 g) masla, kým sa neroztopí, asi 2 minúty. Pokračujeme v zohrievaní, panvicou krúžime a silikónovou stierkou stále miešame, kým maslo nie je tmavozlatohnedé a nevonia orieškovo, ešte 1 až 3 minúty. Panvicu odstavíme z ohňa a hnedé maslo prelejeme do druhej veľkej misy. Do horúceho masla vmiešame zvyšné 3⅓ PL (48 g) masla, kým sa úplne neroztopí.

Zmes necháme 3 minúty postáť, potom šľaháme, kým nie je hustá a lesklá, asi 1 minútu. Silikónovou stierkou alebo drevenou varechou vmiešame múčnu zmes, len kým sa nespojí. 6. Do prázdnej veľkej misy dáme maslo, čokoládu, kakao, instantné espresso a soľ. Pridáme vriacu vodu a šľaháme, kým sa maslo a čokoláda úplne neroztopia, asi 1 minútu. Pridáme cukor, olej, vajcia so žĺtkami a vanilku a vyšľaháme dohladka. Jemne zašľaháme múku, len kým sa nezapracuje. Cesto preložíme do pripravenej formy.

en.t: 200 g graham cracker crumbs, from about 12 to 13 whole graham crackers
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted
one can (397 g) sweetened condensed milk
127 g semisweet chocolate chunks or semisweet chocolate chips
43 g white chocolate chips or white chocolate chunks, or mini white chocolate chips
75 g walnuts or pecans, chopped
45 g large-flake coconut, unsweetened
72 g soft caramel candies (about 6 to 8 individual pieces)
2 tsp (10 ml) milk or heavy cream
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Prepare a 20 cm square pan with a parchment sling or reusable silicone liner, then lightly grease the sides of the pan.

2. In a medium-sized mixing bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs and melted butter. Firmly press the mixture into the bottom of the pan; a flat-bottomed measuring cup or glass helps smooth the bottom. Set aside.
3. Pour the sweetened condensed milk evenly over the crust.
4. Top with chocolate chunks, white chocolate chips, nuts, and coconut flakes.
5. Bake the bars for 25 to 30 minutes, until the coconut is lightly toasted.

6. Allow the bars to cool completely before serving; this will take 60 to 90 minutes at room temperature. Place the bars in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to chill before removing from the pan, cutting, and serving; the bars are easiest to cut when the crust is cold.
7. Combine the caramel with the milk or cream, and heat in the microwave at 5 to 10 second intervals until the caramel is pourable, stirring to combine.
8. Drizzle the caramel over the bars before serving.
9. Store any leftover Seven-Layer Bars, well covered, in the refrigerator for up to one week; freeze for longer storage.

7. Karamel zmiešame s mliekom alebo smotanou a zohrievame v mikrovlnke v 5 až 10-sekundových intervaloch, kým sa karamel nedá liať; medzitým premiešame.
8. Pred podávaním rezy pokvapkáme karamelom.

c.t: Časť A – sušienky s čokoládou (Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies):
1. Rúru rozohrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Dva plechy zľahka vymastíme (alebo vystelieme papierom na pečenie).
2. Vo veľkej mise spojíme cukry, maslo, tuk na pečenie, soľ, vanilkový a mandľový extrakt, ocot a jedlú sódu a šľaháme, kým zmes nie je hladká a krémová.
3. Zašľaháme vajce a znova šľaháme dohladka. Stierkou zotrieme dno a steny misy, aby sa všetko dôkladne spojilo.
4. Primiešame múku, potom čokoládové kúsky.
5. Lyžicou (alebo naberačkou na sušienky s objemom polievkovej lyžice) naberáme guľky cesta s priemerom 3 cm na pripravené plechy a necháme medzi nimi zo všetkých strán 5 cm; pri pečení sa roztečú.
6. Pre lákavú slano-sladkú chuť ich pred vložením do rúry podľa chuti posypeme štipkou morskej soli.
7. Sušienky pečieme 11 až 12 minút, kým okraje nie sú gaštanovohnedé a vrch svetlozlatistý, takmer plavý.
8. Sušienky vyberieme z rúry a necháme ich chladnúť na plechu, kým nestuhnú natoľko, aby sa dali preložiť bez polámania. Zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom.
9. Sušienky dobre zabalené uchovávame pri izbovej teplote až 5 dní; na dlhšie uchovanie ich zamrazíme.
Časť B – ovsené sušienky (Oatmeal Cookies):
1. Rúru rozohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C) s roštom v strede. Dva plechy vystelieme papierom na pečenie alebo ich zľahka vymastíme.

2. Vo veľkej mise ručným elektrickým šľahačom alebo v mise stojanového mixéra s plochým miešadlom vyšľaháme maslo, cukry, škoricu, vanilku, soľ a muškátový oriešok dohladka, v polovici raz zotrieme misu, asi 1 minútu na strednej rýchlosti.
3. Pridáme vajce a šľaháme, kým sa dobre nezapracuje, raz zotrieme misu, asi 1 minútu na strednej rýchlosti.
4. Pridáme múku a prášok do pečiva a na nízkej rýchlosti miešame, kým nevznikne hladké, jednotné cesto, raz zotrieme misu.
5. Pridáme ovsené vločky a hrozienka a na nízkej rýchlosti miešame, kým sa úplne nezapracujú, raz zotrieme misu.

6. Cesto naberáme na pripravené plechy po 3 cm porciách (asi 36 g každá; dobre poslúži naberačka s objemom dvoch polievkových lyžíc) a guľky ukladáme aspoň 5 cm od seba. Ak sme do ovsených sušienok pridali hrozienka, guľky cesta mokrou alebo vymastenou rukou sploštíme na výšku asi 1,5 cm, aby sa pri pečení správne roztiekli.

7. Ovsené sušienky pečieme po jednom plechu 12 až 14 minút. Pre mäkšie sušienky pečieme kratší čas, pre chrumkavejšie dlhší. Po 12 minútach by niekoľko sušienok na okraji plechu malo mať okolo okrajov len náznak svetlohnedej farby. Po 14 minútach by sušienky mali začať hnednúť po celom povrchu.
8. Ovsené sušienky vyberieme z rúry a necháme vychladnúť na plechu. Podávame mierne teplé alebo izbovej teploty.
9. Zvyšné ovsené sušienky uchovávame vo vzduchotesnej nádobe pri izbovej teplote až 4 dni. Na dlhšie uchovanie ich zamrazíme.

Ingredients:
142 g light brown sugar, packed
131 g granulated sugar
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter
92 g vegetable shortening
3/4 tsp (4.5 g) table salt, (use 1/2 tsp (3 g) salt if you use salted butter)
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) almond extract, optional
1 tsp (5 ml) cider vinegar or white vinegar
1 tsp (6 g) baking soda
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)
240 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
340 g semisweet chocolate chips*
Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Lightly grease (or line with parchment) two baking sheets.
2. In a large bowl, combine the sugars, butter, shortening, salt, vanilla and almond extracts, vinegar, and baking soda, beating until smooth and creamy.
3. Beat in the egg, again beating until smooth. Scrape the bottom and sides of the bowl with a spatula to make sure everything is thoroughly combined.
4. Mix in the flour, then the chips.
5. Use a spoon (or a tbsp cookie scoop) to scoop 3 cm balls of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, leaving 5 cm between them on all sides; they'll spread.
6. For enticing salty-sweet flavor, sprinkle a touch of sea salt atop the cookies before putting them in the oven, if desired.
7. Bake the cookies for 11 to 12 minutes, until their edges are chestnut brown and their tops are light golden brown, almost blonde.
8. Remove the cookies from the oven, and cool on the pan until they've set enough to move without breaking. Repeat with the remaining dough.
9. Store cookies, well wrapped, at room temperature for up to 5 days; freeze for longer storage.

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C) with a rack in the center. Line two baking sheets with parchment, or lightly grease.

2. In a large bowl working with an electric hand mixer or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the flat beater attachment, beat together the butter, sugars, cinnamon, vanilla, salt, and nutmeg until smooth, pausing once halfway through to scrape the bowl, about 1 minute on medium speed.
3. Add the egg and beat until well incorporated, pausing once to scrape the bowl, about 1 minute on medium speed.
4. Add the flour and baking powder and mix on low speed to create a smooth, homogenous dough, pausing once to scrape the bowl.
5. Add the oats and raisins, and beat on low speed to incorporate fully, pausing once to scrape the bowl.

6. Scoop the dough into 3 cm portions (about 36 g each) onto the prepared baking sheets (a 2-Tablespoon Scoop works well here), spacing the dough balls at least 5 cm apart. If you’ve added raisins to the oatmeal cookies, use a wet or greased hand to flatten the dough balls to about 1.5 cm in height to ensure the proper spread during baking.

7. Bake the oatmeal cookies one tray at a time for 12 to 14 minutes. For softer cookies, bake for the lesser amount of time; for crunchier cookies, bake for the longer amount. At 12 minutes, a few of the cookies on the edge of the baking sheet should just barely have a bit of a pale brown around their edges. At 14 minutes, the cookies should start to turn brown all over.
8. Remove the oatmeal cookies from the oven and let them cool on the pan. Serve slightly warm or room temperature.
9. Store leftover oatmeal cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days. Freeze for longer storage.

en.t: 115 g unsalted butter (8 tbsp), pliable but cool, about 16 °C
100 g refined coconut oil, firm but creamy, about 21 °C
225 g sugar
1 1/4 tsp (5 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight
7 g vanilla extract (1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml))
1 vanilla bean, split and scraped, pod reserved for another use (optional)
1/4 tsp (1 g) baking powder
1/8 tsp (0.8 g) baking soda
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) almond extract
1 large egg, straight from the fridge (about 50 g)
355 g all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
Powdered sugar, for dusting (optional)

1. Combine butter, coconut oil, sugar, salt, vanilla extract, vanilla seeds (if using), baking powder, baking soda, and almond extract in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Mix on low to moisten, then increase speed to medium and beat until fluffy and light, about 5 minutes. Pause to scrape the bowl with a flexible spatula, then beat a minute more. In chilly winter months, this process may take longer.

2. With the mixer running, crack in the egg and continue beating until smooth. Reduce speed to low, add flour, and mix until dough begins to gather around the paddle but the flour hasn't quite disappeared. Fold once or twice with a flexible spatula to ensure the dough is well combined. Divide in half and proceed to the next step, or wrap in plastic and refrigerate up to 1 week. Refrigerated dough should be left to stand at room temperature until soft and pliable, then lightly kneaded to restore its plasticity before rolling.

3. When ready to bake, adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). On a generously floured surface, roll a portion of the dough to a thickness of 0.5 cm; check with a ruler to make sure your dough isn't too thin, or else the finished cookies will be more inclined to break. Slide an offset spatula underneath the dough to loosen. Cut with assorted cookie cutters and transfer to a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, leaving at least 2.5 cm of space in between cookies. Knead scraps together, then roll and cut as before. Repeat with remaining dough.

4. Transfer to oven to bake. For soft cookies, bake until puffed and firm but perfectly pale, about 12 minutes. For crisp cookies, continue baking until pale gold around the very edges, about 3 minutes more. Let the cookies cool to room temperature directly on the baking sheet, about 30 minutes. The true flavor and texture of the cookies will take another 30 minutes to develop. If you like, finish with a dusting of powdered sugar, or decorate with a not-too-sweet royal icing. Store in an airtight container up to 1 week at room temperature.

1. Do misy stojanového mixéra s plochým miešadlom dáme maslo, kokosový tuk, cukor, soľ, vanilkový extrakt, vanilkové semienka (ak ich používame), kypriaci prášok, jedlú sódu a mandľový extrakt. Miešame na nízkych otáčkach, aby sa prísady navlhčili, potom zvýšime na stredné otáčky a šľaháme, kým zmes nie je nadýchaná a ľahká, asi 5 minút. Zastavíme, misu vyškrabeme pružnou stierkou a šľaháme ešte minútu. V chladných zimných mesiacoch to môže trvať dlhšie.

2. Za chodu mixéra rozbijeme do misy vajce a šľaháme dohladka. Znížime otáčky, pridáme múku a miešame, kým sa cesto nezačne zhlukovať okolo miešadla, ale múka ešte celkom nezmizla. Raz či dvakrát preložíme pružnou stierkou, aby bolo cesto dobre spojené. Rozdelíme na polovice a pokračujeme ďalším krokom, alebo zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke až 1 týždeň. Cesto z chladničky necháme postáť pri izbovej teplote, kým nie je mäkké a poddajné, potom ho zľahka premiesime, aby sa mu vrátila plastickosť, a až potom vaľkáme.

3. Keď sme pripravení piecť, rošt nastavíme do dolnej tretiny rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Na štedro pomúčenej ploche vyvaľkáme časť cesta na hrúbku 0,5 cm; pravítkom skontrolujeme, či nie je príliš tenké, inak by sa hotové keksy ľahšie lámali. Pod cesto zasunieme zahnutú stierku, aby sme ho uvoľnili. Vykrajujeme rôznymi vykrajovačkami a preložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierom na pečenie, aspoň 2,5 cm od seba. Zvyšky cesta spojíme, vyvaľkáme a vykrajujeme ako predtým. Zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom.

en.t: 255 g all-purpose flour

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Line a 23 × 33 cm rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, white whole wheat flour, cornstarch, caster sugar, and salt until combined.

3. In a small saucepan, heat butter over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until melted, about 5 minutes. (Alternatively, melt butter in a medium bowl or measuring cup in the microwave.) Pour melted butter into the flour mixture and, using a rubber spatula or dough scraper, incorporate butter into dry ingredients, gently stirring and pressing to combine, until a cohesive dough just forms and no dry bits remain, about 1 minute. (Be careful not to overwork the dough.)

4. Using clean hands press the dough into the prepared baking sheet and, using an offset spatula or the flat bottom of a glass or measuring cup, smooth dough out into an even layer. Bake until fragrant and light golden, about 35 to 40 minutes.

5. Remove shortbread from oven and sprinkle top with 3 tbsp (36 g) caster sugar. Using a knife, cut shortbread into individual portions while still warm. Allow shortbread to cool completely in the baking sheet, about 1 hour. Shake excess sugar off individual portions and serve.

en.t: 61 g vegetable shortening or 8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, for softer cookies
99 g granulated sugar
106 g light brown sugar, packed
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
198 g peanut butter*
180 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 tsp (6 g) baking soda
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Lightly grease (or line with parchment) two baking sheets.
2. Beat together the shortening or butter, sugars, egg, vanilla, and peanut butter until smooth.

3. Add the flour, baking soda, and salt to the peanut-butter mixture, beating gently until everything is well combined. It may take a while for this rather dry dough to come together; and when it does, it'll be quite stiff. Only if necessary, drizzle in enough water to make the dough cohesive.
4. Drop the cookie dough by tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets (a tbsp cookie scoop works well here), leaving 5 cm between them.
5. Use a fork to flatten each cookie to about 1.5 cm thick, making a cross-hatch design.
6. Bake the peanut butter cookies for 12 to 16 minutes, until they're barely beginning to brown around the edges; the tops won't have browned. Remove them from the oven, and cool on a rack.
7. Store well-wrapped peanut butter cookies at room temperature for a week or so; freeze for longer storage.

en.v: To make ahead, divide portioned dough between heavy-duty zipper-lock bags and refrigerate up to one week (or freeze for up to three months). Soften the dough at room temperature until roughly 20 °C, then roll, coat, flatten, and bake as directed.

sk.v: Ak chceme pripraviť vopred, naporciované cesto rozdelíme do pevných uzatvárateľných vreciek a uchovávame v chladničke až týždeň (alebo zmrazíme až na tri mesiace). Cesto necháme zmäknúť pri izbovej teplote zhruba na 20 °C, potom ho vyvaľkáme, obalíme, sploštíme a upečieme podľa postupu.

en.t: 114 g unsalted butter, firm but pliable, about 16 °C
85 g virgin coconut oil (heaping)
298 g sugar
1 1/4 tsp (6 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume or use the same weight)
1 tsp (4 g) baking powder
15 g vanilla extract (about 1 tbsp (15 ml))
1 large egg, straight from the fridge (about 50 g)
295 g low-protein all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal (spooned)
57 g sugar
2 3/4 tsp (5 g) ground cinnamon
1 1/2 tsp (1.25 g) freshly grated cinnamon

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Combine butter, coconut oil, sugar, salt, baking powder, and vanilla in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Mix at low speed to combine, then increase to medium and beat until soft, fluffy, and pale, about 5 minutes, although the exact timing will vary. Halfway through, pause to scrape the bowl and beater with a flexible spatula, then resume mixing on medium speed. Add egg and continue beating until smooth. Reduce speed to low, add flour, and mix to form a stiff dough.

2. Using a cookie scoop, divide dough into 2-tbsp portions. If you like, these can be transferred to a zipper-lock bag and refrigerated for up to 1 week, or frozen for up to 3 months; soften to about 20 °C before baking.

3. For the Cinnamon Sugar: Mix sugar with ground and grated cinnamon in a small bowl, adding more spice if you prefer. (It should taste very intense to offset the mild dough.) Roll each portion of dough into a smooth and sticky ball, then tumble in cinnamon sugar until fully coated.

4. Arrange on a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, leaving 6.5 cm between balls, then flatten into 5 cm disks about 1.5 cm thick. Generously cover with the remaining cinnamon sugar, creating a thick layer that will crack and crinkle in the oven.

5. Bake until the snickerdoodles begin to spread, about 5 minutes, then reduce temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Continue baking until firm around the edges but steamy in the middle, about 6 minutes longer. Cool directly on baking sheet until the crumb is set, about 8 minutes. Enjoy warm, or store in an airtight container for up to 3 days at room temperature.

en.t: 115 g unsalted butter, creamy and soft, about 20 °C (about 8 tbsp)
115 g light brown sugar (gently packed)
115 g plain, unsulfured baking molasses, such as Golden Barrel or Grandma's, not blackstrap
15 g vanilla extract (about 1 tbsp (15 ml))
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) orange zest
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) ground ginger
1 1/4 tsp (6 ml) ground cinnamon
3/4 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use about half as much by volume or the same weight salt
1/2 tsp (3 g) baking soda
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) ground cloves
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) ground coriander
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) freshly grated nutmeg
A few cracks of medium-grind black pepper
270 g low-protein all-purpose flour, such as Gold Medal, plus more for dusting (about 2 tbsp)
Royal Icing to decorate, optional

1. Combine butter, brown sugar, molasses, vanilla extract, orange zest, ginger, cinnamon, salt, baking soda, cloves, coriander, nutmeg, and black pepper in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment. Mix on low speed to moisten, then increase to medium and beat until fluffy, soft, and light, about 5 minutes, pausing to scrape the bowl and beater about halfway through. In chilly winter months, this process may take longer.

2. Reduce mixing speed to low and add the flour all at once; continue mixing until well combined. Scrape the bowl and beater well with a flexible spatula, then knead against the sides of the bowl to form a smooth ball. Divide in half and flatten into discs. If comfortable working with a soft dough, use immediately; if not, wrap in plastic and refrigerate until cool and firm (timing will vary depending on personal preference). If refrigerated for longer than a few hours, let the dough stand at room temperature until softened to about 21 °C before use, then knead on a bare, unfloured surface until pliable and smooth.

3. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). On a flour-dusted surface, roll a portion of dough into a 18 cm square. Sprinkle with flour, flip to sprinkle the other side, and continue rolling until 0.5 cm thick, repositioning as needed to ensure the dough does not stick. After rolling, brush away the excess flour and slide an offset spatula under the dough to loosen before stamping into shapes with assorted cutters. Arrange cut-outs on a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, leaving at least 0.5 cm between each. Gather scraps, knead, re-roll, and cut as before (any scraps leftover from this second stage can be baked off to grind as cookie crumbs). Repeat with the remaining portion of dough.

4. Bake the gingerbread until firm and dry to the touch, about 12 minutes, and cool to room temperature directly on the baking sheet. If you like, decorate as desired with royal icing, and dry completely before storage (this can take 12-24 hours depending on thickness of design, ambient humidity, and air flow).
5. With or without frosting, the gingerbread cookies will last up to 3 weeks at cool room temperature in an airtight container.

1. Do misy stojanového mixéra s plochým miešadlom dáme maslo, hnedý cukor, melasu, vanilkový extrakt, pomarančovú kôru, zázvor, škoricu, soľ, jedlú sódu, klinčeky, koriander, muškátový oriešok a čierne korenie. V chladných zimných mesiacoch to môže trvať dlhšie.

2. Znížime otáčky a naraz pridáme všetku múku; miešame, kým sa dobre nespojí. Misu aj miešadlo dôkladne vyškrabeme pružnou stierkou a cesto premiesime o steny misy do hladkej gule. Rozdelíme na polovice a sploštíme na disky. Ak nám nevadí pracovať s mäkkým cestom, použijeme ho hneď; inak ho zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke, kým nie je chladné a pevné (čas závisí od osobnej preferencie). Posypeme múkou, obrátime, posypeme aj druhú stranu a vaľkáme ďalej na hrúbku 0,5 cm; cesto podľa potreby posúvame, aby sa neprilepilo. Po vyvaľkaní zmetieme prebytočnú múku a pod cesto zasunieme zahnutú stierku, aby sme ho uvoľnili, a potom vykrajujeme rôznymi vykrajovačkami. en.t: 285 g all-purpose flour (spooned), plus more for dusting
245 g sugar
1/2 tsp (2 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use about half as much by volume or the same weight
1 1/4 tsp (5 g) baking powder
150 g whole almonds, toasted and roughly chopped
2 1/4 tsp (11 ml) whole anise seed, roughly chopped
3 large eggs, straight from the fridge (about 150 g)
15 g vanilla extract (about 1 tbsp (15 ml))

1. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, chopped toasted almonds, and chopped anise seeds. Mix on low until homogeneous, then add eggs and vanilla; continue to mix just long enough to form a soft dough.

2. Transfer dough to a lightly floured surface. Knead lightly to bring dough together into a ball, then shape into a roughly 20 cm log. Transfer dough log to a parchment-lined half-sheet pan and continue rolling the log by hand until it is approximately 41 cm long. Gently flatten dough by hand until log is about 10 cm wide and just over 1.5 cm thick.

3. Bake dough until puffed and firm to the touch and just beginning to brown around the very edges (though still pale overall), about 25 minutes. Cool directly on baking sheet for about 5 minutes, then transfer to a cutting board and let cool 5 minutes more. While dough is still warm, use a long, thin, and very sharp serrated knife to cut log at a slight angle into about 25 pieces, each just over 1.5 cm wide.

4. Arrange biscotti, cut sides up, on a parchment-lined baking sheet and continue baking until dry to the touch and lightly browned, about 12 minutes. Flip biscotti over and continue baking for another 12 minutes. It's normal for the timing to vary according to the biscotti's size and thickness, as well as differences in oven temperature and airflow, so keep a close eye on them and adjust the bake time as needed.

5. Cool biscotti to room temperature before serving. If desired, dip in tempered chocolate (be sure to brush crumbs from each piece before dipping). With or without chocolate, the biscotti will keep for about 3 months in an airtight container at cool room temperature.

en.t: 16 tbsp (227 g) unsalted butter
99 g granulated sugar
113 g light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, lightly packed
2 large eggs (≈100 g without shell), separated
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
48 g King Arthur Almond Flour or 40 g pecan meal
300–360 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
85–113 g finely diced chopped nuts
255 g icing, jam, or the filling of your choice
1. Line two baking sheets with parchment, or use a non-stick baking sheet; greasing the pans isn't sufficient to prevent sticking.
2. In a large bowl, beat the butter and sugars until very light.
3. Beat in the egg yolks, vanilla, and salt.
4. Add the nut flour and the lesser amount of all-purpose flour, stirring until well blended. If the dough seems too sticky, add just enough additional flour to make it workable.
5. Cover and chill the dough for an hour.
6. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C).
7. While the dough chills, cover the egg whites and leave them out of the refrigerator to warm up to room temperature.
8. In a small bowl, whip the egg whites until they're foamy.
9. Break off pieces of dough and roll them between your palms to form 2.5 cm balls.
10. Dip the balls into the egg whites, and roll them in the chopped nuts. Place the cookies about 5 cm apart on the prepared baking sheets.
11. Bake the thumbprint cookies for 8 minutes, then remove them from the oven.
12. Make a deep thumbprint in the center of each cookie.
13. Return to the oven, and bake until they're a light, golden brown, about 4 to 6 minutes.
14. Remove the thumbprint cookies from the oven, and transfer them to a rack to cool.
15. Fill the thumbprint with the filling of your choice, using about 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) for each. Serve the thumbprint cookies at room temperature.

en.t: 283 g unbleached all-purpose flour, for the cookies
4 tbsp (21 g) Dutch-processed cocoa, sifted, for the cookies
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt, for the cookies
16 tbsp (225 g) unsalted butter, softened but still cool, for the cookies
149 g granulated sugar, for the cookies
57 g confectioners' sugar, for the cookies
2 large egg yolks, for the cookies
57 g semisweet chocolate, melted and cooled, for the cookies
2 tsp (10 ml) vanilla extract, for the cookies
340 g white chocolate, chopped
115 g sour cream

1. Make the cookies: Whisk the flour, cocoa, and salt together in a medium bowl. By hand or with an electric mixer, beat the butter and both sugars at medium speed until light and fluffy, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes. Scrape the bowl, add the yolks, melted chocolate, and vanilla, and beat until incorporated, 15 to 20 seconds. Scrape the bowl, add the dry ingredients, and mix at low speed until a dough forms, 25 to 30 seconds.

2. The dough should be soft but not sticky; if it is sticky, chill it for 10 to 15 minutes. Divide it in half and roll each half into a log 15 cm long and 5 cm thick. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 3 days (or freeze for up to 1 month, wrapped in plastic and then foil).

3. Adjust the oven racks to the upper- and lower-middle positions and heat the oven to 165 °C (fan 145 °C). Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment. Slice the logs 3 mm thick and place the slices 1.5 to 2.5 cm apart on the sheets. Bake until the edges begin to brown, 12 to 13 minutes (a minute or two less than for standard thick icebox cookies), rotating the sheets halfway through. Cool on the sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack and cool completely. (The cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 days.)
4. Melt the white chocolate in a double boiler. Stir in 115 g sour cream and cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes.
5. Spread the mixture on the flat side of half the cookies and top with the remaining cookies. Serve within 2 hours.

1. Pripravíme sušienky: v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, kakao a soľ. Ručne alebo elektrickým šľahačom vyšľaháme maslo s oboma druhmi cukru na strednej rýchlosti do svetla a nadýchana, 1 až 1 1/2 minúty. Stierkou zotrieme steny misy, pridáme žĺtky, roztopenú čokoládu a vanilku a šľaháme, kým sa nespoja, 15 až 20 sekúnd. Znova zotrieme steny misy, pridáme suché suroviny a na nízkej rýchlosti miešame, kým nevznikne cesto, 25 až 30 sekúnd.

2. Cesto má byť mäkké, ale nie lepkavé; ak sa lepí, necháme ho 10 až 15 minút vychladiť. Rozdelíme ho na polovice a z každej vyvaľkáme valček dlhý 15 cm a hrubý 5 cm. Zabalíme do fólie a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 2 hodiny alebo až na 3 dni (alebo zamrazíme až na 1 mesiac, zabalené vo fólii a potom v alobale).

Necháme 2 minúty chladnúť na plechoch, potom preložíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť. (Vo vzduchotesnej nádobe vydržia až 2 dni.)
4. Bielu čokoládu roztopíme vo vodnom kúpeli. Vmiešame 115 g kyslej smotany a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, asi 15 minút.

en.v: Nanaimo bars can be up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. To freeze Nanaimo bars, tightly wrap individual slices in a layer of plastic wrap and then a layer of foil, and freeze in an airtight container. Nanaimo bars can be frozen for up to 2 months.

en.t: Nonstick baking spray
180 g graham crackers (crushed)
98 g sweetened shredded coconut
65 g walnuts
113 g unsalted butter (8 tbsp)
67 g granulated sugar
26 g unsweetened cocoa powder (about 5 tbsp), sifted
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell), beaten
84 g unsalted butter (about 6 tbsp), softened
173 g powdered sugar
36 g custard powder, such as Bird’s (3 tbsp (44 ml))
2 tbsp (30 ml) whole milk
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla extract
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
170 g semi-sweet or dark chocolate, chopped
42 g unsalted butter (3 tbsp)

1. Using nonstick baking spray, grease a 20 × 20 cm baking pan. Alternatively, line the baking pan with 2 long strips of parchment to cover the bottom and sides, creasing as needed to ensure a secure fit.
2. For the Crust: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse together graham crackers, shredded coconut, and walnuts until finely ground. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl.

3. Place butter in a medium heatproof bowl and set over a saucepan of simmering water. When butter is melted, whisk in sugar and cocoa powder until dissolved, then add beaten egg. Mix until smooth and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes.

4. Pour melted butter mixture over graham cracker crumbs, tossing to evenly coat crumbs in chocolate and butter mixture. Gently knead until cohesive and transfer to prepared baking pan. Spread into an even layer, then compress firmly with a flat-bottomed drinking glass or measuring cup. Place in the freezer until firm, about 10 minutes.

5. For the Custard Filling: In a medium bowl, use a hand mixer to beat butter, powdered sugar, custard powder, milk, vanilla, and salt on medium speed until smooth, about 3 minutes. (Alternatively, in a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat softened butter, powdered sugar, custard powder, milk, vanilla, and salt on medium speed until smooth, about 3 minutes.) Remove crust from freezer and, using a flexible or offset spatula, spread custard filling over the crust. Refrigerate until set, about 1 hour, then transfer baking pan to freezer until ready to top with chocolate.

6. For the Chocolate Layer: In a medium heat-proof bowl, combine chopped chocolate and butter. Set bowl over a saucepan of barely simmering water, stirring frequently, until chopped chocolate and butter are melted, about 5 minutes. Whisk until smooth and remove from heat.
7. Remove baking pan from the freezer. Using an offset spatula, spread chocolate mixture over chilled custard filling to evenly cover bars. Refrigerate bars until fully set, about 30 minutes.

c.t: 1. Using nonstick baking spray, grease a 20 × 20 cm baking pan. Alternatively, line the baking pan with 2 long strips of parchment to cover the bottom and sides, creasing as needed to ensure a secure fit.
2. For the Crust: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse together graham crackers, shredded coconut, and walnuts until finely ground. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl.

3. Place butter in a medium heatproof bowl and set over a saucepan of simmering water. When butter is melted, whisk in sugar and cocoa powder until dissolved, then add beaten egg. Mix until smooth and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes.

4. Pour melted butter mixture over graham cracker crumbs, tossing to evenly coat crumbs in chocolate and butter mixture. Gently knead until cohesive and transfer to prepared baking pan. Spread into an even layer, then compress firmly with a flat-bottomed drinking glass or measuring cup. Place in the freezer until firm, about 10 minutes.

5. For the Custard Filling: In a medium bowl, use a hand mixer to beat butter, powdered sugar, custard powder, milk, vanilla, and salt on medium speed until smooth, about 3 minutes. (Alternatively, in a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat softened butter, powdered sugar, custard powder, milk, vanilla, and salt on medium speed until smooth, about 3 minutes.) Remove crust from freezer and, using a flexible or offset spatula, spread custard filling over the crust. Refrigerate until set, about 1 hour, then transfer baking pan to freezer until ready to top with chocolate.

6. For the Chocolate Layer: In a medium heat-proof bowl, combine chopped chocolate and butter. Set bowl over a saucepan of barely simmering water, stirring frequently, until chopped chocolate and butter are melted, about 5 minutes. Whisk until smooth and remove from heat.
7. Remove baking pan from the freezer. Using an offset spatula, spread chocolate mixture over chilled custard filling to evenly cover bars. Refrigerate bars until fully set, about 30 minutes.

8. Using a hot knife, slice bars and serve. If not serving immediately, return bars to refrigerator until ready to serve. (For cleaner cuts, run knife under warm water and carefully dry the knife with a clean kitchen towel before portioning each slice.)

1. Štvorcovú formu 20 × 20 cm vymastíme nepriľnavým sprejom na pečenie. Prípadne ju vystelieme 2 dlhými pásmi papiera na pečenie, ktoré pokryjú dno aj steny; podľa potreby ich prehneme, aby dobre priliehali.
2. **NA KORPUS:** V kuchynskom robote pulzne pomelieme nadrobno sušienky graham, strúhaný kokos a vlašské orechy. Zmes preložíme do stredne veľkej misy.

3. Maslo dáme do stredne veľkej žiaruvzdornej misy a položíme ju na hrniec s mierne vriacou vodou. Keď sa maslo roztopí, vyšľaháme s cukrom a kakaom, kým sa nerozpustia, potom pridáme rozšľahané vajce. Miešame, kým zmes nie je hladká a mierne nezhustne, asi 2 minúty.

4. Roztopenú maslovú zmes nalejeme na omrvinky zo sušienok a premiešame, aby sa omrvinky rovnomerne obalili čokoládovo-maslovou zmesou. Jemne premiesime, kým nie je zmes súdržná, a preložíme do pripravenej formy. Rozotrieme do rovnomernej vrstvy a pevne natlačíme pohárom alebo odmerkou s plochým dnom. Dáme do mrazničky, kým nestuhne, asi 10 minút.

5. **NA KRÉMOVÚ PLNKU:** V stredne veľkej mise ručným mixérom vyšľaháme na stredných otáčkach maslo, práškový cukor, pudingový prášok, mlieko, vanilku a soľ dohladka, asi 3 minúty. (Prípadne v stojanovom mixéri s plochým miešadlom vyšľaháme zmäknuté maslo, práškový cukor, pudingový prášok, mlieko, vanilku a soľ na stredných otáčkach dohladka, asi 3 minúty.) Korpus vyberieme z mrazničky a pružnou alebo zahnutou stierkou naň rozotrieme krémovú plnku. Necháme stuhnúť v chladničke, asi 1 hodinu, potom formu preložíme do mrazničky, kým nepridáme čokoládovú vrstvu.

6. **NA ČOKOLÁDOVÚ VRSTVU:** V stredne veľkej žiaruvzdornej mise zmiešame nasekanú čokoládu s maslom. Misu položíme na hrniec s sotva vriacou vodou a za častého miešania zohrievame, kým sa čokoláda a maslo neroztopia, asi 5 minút. Vyšľaháme dohladka a odstavíme z ohňa.
7. Formu vyberieme z mrazničky. Zahnutou stierkou rozotrieme čokoládovú zmes na vychladenú krémovú plnku, aby rezy rovnomerne pokryla. Rezy necháme v chladničke úplne stuhnúť, asi 30 minút.
8. Horúcim nožom nakrájame rezy a podávame. Ak ich nepodávame hneď, vrátime ich do chladničky. (Na čistejšie rezy nôž pred každým rezom ponoríme do teplej vody a opatrne ho osušíme čistou utierkou.)

en.t: 89 g old-fashioned rolled oats*
160 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
149 g granulated sugar
1/8 tsp (0.8 g) table salt
64 g sweetened or 40 g unsweetened shredded coconut
8 tbsp (113 g) butter*
2 tbsp (43 g) golden syrup or dark corn syrup
1 tsp (6 g) baking soda
2 tbsp (28 g) water, boiling
1. Preheat the oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Lightly grease two baking sheets, or line them with parchment paper. Weigh your flour.
2. Stir together the oats, flour, sugar, salt, and coconut.
3. Place the butter and syrup in a small saucepan or microwave-safe container, and cook or microwave until the butter has melted and the mixture is bubbling.

4. In a medium-sized bowl, combine the baking soda and boiling water, then stir in the hot butter. Be prepared: the mixture will bubble up energetically. This is why you're using a medium (rather than small) bowl.
5. Stir the butter mixture into the dry ingredients.
6. Drop the dough, by teaspoonfuls, onto the prepared baking sheets. A tsp cookie scoop works well here. Leave at least 4 cm between them; they'll spread a bit.
7. Bake the cookies for 13 to 15 minutes, until they're a deep mahogany brown; the cookies are meant to be crisp/crunchy and dark brown, not chewy/light brown.
8. Remove the cookies from the oven, and cool them right on the pan. Store, well wrapped, for a week or so at room temperature; freeze for longer storage.

en.t: 250 g all-purpose flour, sifted, plus more for dusting
125 g confectioners' sugar, sifted
50 g blanched almond flour, sifted
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
125 g unsalted butter, cold and cut into 1.5 cm cubes
50 g beaten egg (from 1 large egg)
Demerara sugar (optional), for rolling

1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk flour, confectioners' sugar, almond flour, and salt to combine. Add butter to flour mixture and toss with fingers until butter pieces are thoroughly coated with flour mixture. Using your fingertips, pinch and flatten butter, then rub it between your fingertips until a sandy texture forms, 3 to 4 minutes.
2. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture about 5–7.5 cm wide. Pour beaten egg into the well and, using a fork, gradually incorporate flour into the egg until a dry, crumbly dough forms.

3. Tip dough onto a large, clean, unfloured countertop. Using the heel of your hand, smear the dough away from you, then use your hands or a dough scraper to gather it back into a mass. Repeat until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms, about 6 to 8 more times.

4. On a clean cutting board or work surface, shape dough into a 25 cm long log about 4–5 cm in diameter. (If desired, roll log in an even layer of demerara sugar for added sweetness and crunch.) Wrap log tightly in plastic, twisting the ends of the plastic to seal. Once wrapped, roll log under your hands in a back-and-forth motion to ensure log is smooth, even, and tight all around. Refrigerate until very firm, about 3 hours. Line two 33 × 46 cm rimmed baking sheets with parchment; set aside.

5. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Using a sharp chef's knife, trim ends of log, then slice dough into 0.5 cm thick slices. Transfer sliced cookies onto prepared baking sheets and freeze until firm, about 30 minutes. (You may have to freeze 1 baking sheet at a time, depending on the size of your freezer.)

6. Bake 1 sheet of cookies at 175 °C (fan 155 °C) until lightly golden brown around the edges, about 15 minutes, leaving second sheet in the freezer while the first bakes. Repeat with remaining baking sheet.
7. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving; enjoy warm or at room temperature.

1. Vo veľkej mise metličkou premiešame múku, práškový cukor, mandľovú múku a soľ. Pridáme maslo a prstami ho premiešame s múčnou zmesou, kým nie sú všetky kúsky masla obalené. 2. Do stredu múčnej zmesi urobíme jamku širokú asi 5 – 7,5 cm. Vlejeme do nej rozšľahané vajce a vidličkou postupne zapracúvame múku do vajca, kým nevznikne suché, drobivé cesto.

3. Cesto vyklopíme na veľkú čistú nepomúčenú pracovnú dosku. Spodnou časťou dlane cesto rozotierame smerom od seba, potom ho rukami alebo škrabkou na cesto zhrnieme späť. Opakujeme ešte asi 6 – 8-krát, kým nevznikne mäkké, mierne lepkavé cesto.

4. Na čistej doske na krájanie alebo pracovnej ploche vytvarujeme z cesta valček dlhý 25 cm s priemerom asi 4 – 5 cm. (Ak chceme, valček obalíme v rovnomernej vrstve cukru demerara, aby boli sušienky sladšie a chrumkavejšie.) Valček pevne zabalíme do fólie a konce fólie zatočíme. Zabalený valček pogúľame dlaňami tam a späť, aby bol hladký, rovnomerný a pevný po celej dĺžke. Dáme ho do chladničky, kým úplne nestuhne, asi 3 hodiny. Dva plechy s okrajom 33 × 46 cm vystelieme papierom na pečenie a odložíme.

5. Mriežku v rúre dáme do stredu a rúru rozohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Ostrým kuchárskym nožom zarovnáme konce valčeka a nakrájame ho na plátky hrubé 0,5 cm. Sušienky preložíme na pripravené plechy a dáme ich do mrazničky, kým nestuhnú, asi 30 minút. (Podľa veľkosti mrazničky možno budeme mraziť plechy po jednom.)

6. Pečieme vždy 1 plech sušienok pri 175 °C (teplovzdušná 155 °C), kým nie sú po okrajoch svetlo zlatistohnedé, asi 15 minút; druhý plech medzitým necháme v mrazničke. Potom rovnako upečieme druhý plech.
7. Necháme 10 minút vychladnúť a podávame teplé alebo izbovej teploty.

en.v: Tuiles can be stored airtight for up to 10 days; fill them just before serving so they don't soften.

en.t: 104 g King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
113 g confectioners' sugar
1/8 tsp (0.8 g) table salt
8 tbsp (113 g) unsalted butter, melted
4 large egg whites (≈120 g), room temperature
1 tsp (5 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1. Sift the flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt together twice. Place in a small bowl.
2. Whisk in the melted butter, egg whites, and vanilla until you have a thin, very smooth batter. If any lumps remain, pass the batter through a fine sieve.

3. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours, but no longer. Stir and check the consistency of the batter. If it seems thick, add milk 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) at a time until the batter is thin again. Preheat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C) towards the end of the rest/chill time.

4. Lay a clean sheet of parchment on a flat baking sheet. Scoop out 2 tsp (10 ml) of dough, spaced about 13 cm to 15 cm apart on the sheet. Make only 2 tuiles at a time; you must work with them quickly after they come out of the oven.
5. Use a thin spreader to smooth the batter out to a 10 cm to 13 cm circle. The batter will be nearly transparent. Bake for 4 to 5 minutes, just until the very edge of the circle begins to color.

6. Working very quickly, peel each tuile off the parchment and form into the desired shape. You can lay the tuiles over a rolling pin or a clean glass bottle to form shells; or roll around the handle of a round wooden spoon to form cigars. Use a larger round to form cannoli-sized tubes for filling. For a truly stunning shape, drape a hot tuile over the base of a lightly greased heat-proof shot glass, pressing to form an upside-down flower. Remove the cooled tuile and stand right side up, ready for filling.

7. Tuiles can be stored airtight for up to 10 days, and filled with pastry cream, mousse, sweetened whipped cream, and/or fruit. Fill just before serving so that the delicate tuiles don't soften from the moisture in the filling.

1. Múku, práškový cukor a soľ spolu dvakrát preosejeme. Dáme do malej misy.
2. Zašľaháme roztopené maslo, bielky a vanilku, kým nevznikne riedke, veľmi hladké cesto. Ak zostanú hrudky, cesto pretlačíme cez jemné sitko.

3. Misu prikryjeme a necháme v chladničke 1 až 2 hodiny, nie dlhšie. Premiešame a skontrolujeme hustotu cesta. Ak sa zdá husté, pridávame mlieko po ½ ČL (2,5 ml), kým cesto nie je opäť riedke. Ku koncu odpočinku rúru predhrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C).

4. Na rovný plech položíme čistý papier na pečenie. Naberieme 2 ČL (10 ml) cesta a kôpky rozložíme na papier asi 13 až 15 cm od seba. Naraz pripravujeme len 2 tuiles; po vybratí z rúry s nimi musíme pracovať rýchlo.
5. Tenkou stierkou rozotrieme cesto na kruh s priemerom 10 až 13 cm. Cesto bude takmer priesvitné. Pečieme 4 až 5 minút, len kým samý okraj kruhu nezačne farbiť.

6. Veľmi rýchlo každú tuile odlepíme od papiera a vytvarujeme do želaného tvaru. Tuiles môžeme položiť na valček alebo čistú sklenenú fľašu, aby vznikli mušle; alebo ich navinúť na rúčku okrúhlej drevenej varechy, aby vznikli cigary. Na väčšej okrúhlej forme vytvarujeme trubičky veľkosti cannoli na plnenie. Na naozaj pôsobivý tvar položíme horúcu tuile na dno zľahka vymasteného žiaruvzdorného poldecového pohárika a pritlačíme, aby vznikol obrátený kvet. Vychladnutú tuile zložíme a postavíme správnou stranou nahor, pripravenú na plnenie.

7. Tuiles vydržia vo vzduchotesnej nádobe až 10 dní a môžeme ich plniť cukrárskym krémom, penou, osladenou šľahačkou alebo ovocím. Plníme ich tesne pred podávaním, aby jemné tuiles nezmäkli od vlhkosti plnky.

en.v: The source offers vanilla extract (contains alcohol) or grated lemon or orange rind or ground ginger as the flavouring; use the rind or ginger, or alcohol-free vanilla extract.

sk.v: Zdroj ako aromatickú prísadu uvádza vanilkový extrakt (obsahuje alkohol) alebo nastrúhanú citrónovú či pomarančovú kôru, alebo mletý zázvor; použijeme kôru alebo zázvor, prípadne vanilkový extrakt bez alkoholu.

en.t: 2 tbsp (28 g) unsalted butter at room temperature
66 g of sugar
1 tsp (5 ml) of either vanilla extract or grated rind of lemon or orange or ground ginger
Pinch of salt
2 egg whites (≈60 g), at room temperature
40 g of flour
1. Preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C).
2. Butter and flour two baking sheets.

3. Beat the butter, sugar, vanilla, and salt until pale and fluffy. Beat the egg whites for 1 minute, until they mound slightly. Add the egg whites and mix just enough to blend. Add the flour through a sieve, shaking it over the batter and folding it in quickly.

4. Using a dinner knife, scoop up about 1 tsp (5 ml) batter and tap it onto the cookie sheet. Press the knife down onto the batter so you have a line 6.5 cm. Spread the batter on the sheet in this manner, leaving 5 cm between each cookie.

5. Bake for 4-5 minutes in the middle of the oven, until the cookies have browned slightly at the edges. Remove with a metal spatula and cool on a rack. If the cookies harden before you take them off the sheet, return them to the oven to warm them.
6. When the cookies have cooled, store them in an airtight container.

en.v: 12-cup (12-mould) nonstick madeleine pan, 1-tbsp cookie scoop or measuring spoon, digital scale, wire rack

sk.v: Nepriľnavá forma na madlienky s 12 jamkami (12 formičiek), naberačka na cesto 1 PL alebo odmerka, digitálna váha, mriežka

en.v: The batter can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated for up to 2 days. Madeleines are best enjoyed on the same day they’re baked.

sk.v: Cesto môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke až 2 dni. Madlienky sú najlepšie v deň upečenia.

c.t: The madeleines can be flavoured with almond extract and/or 1 to 2 tsp freshly grated lemon or orange zest.
Madlienky môžete ochutiť mandľovým extraktom a/alebo 1 až 2 ČL čerstvo nastrúhanej citrónovej či pomarančovej kôry.

en.t: 75 g all-purpose flour
75 g granulated sugar
1/2 tsp (2 g) baking powder
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
2 large eggs (100 g), well beaten
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) vanilla extract, optional
75 g unsalted butter (about 5 tbsp), melted and slightly cooled, plus extra for greasing

1. In a medium bowl, thoroughly whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt, about 30 seconds. Add eggs and vanilla extract, if using, and whisk until a thick batter forms, about 30 seconds. Add butter and whisk until fully incorporated and batter is smooth and slightly shiny, about 1 minute. Cover bowl with plastic wrap (or transfer to an airtight container) and refrigerate for at least 4 hours and up to 2 days.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Set a nonstick madeleine pan inside a rimmed baking sheet. Using a pastry brush, grease madeleine pan with melted butter. Using a 1-tbsp cookie scoop or measuring spoon, add 20 g (slightly more than 1 tbsp (14 g)) of batter into the center of each cup. The batter will spread as it bakes.
3. Bake madeleines for 3 minutes then reduce oven temperature to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Continue to bake until madeleines are domed in the center and golden brown around the edges, about 8 minutes.

4. Remove madeleines from oven and immediately invert the hot pan over a wire rack, gently rapping the pan to release the madeleines. (Letting the madeleines cool even slightly in the pan will make it difficult to remove them from the pan.) Flip madeleines over so that the shell pattern is on the bottom and let cool slightly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

1. V stredne veľkej mise dôkladne vyšľaháme múku, cukor, kypriaci prášok a soľ, asi 30 sekúnd. en.t: 288 g King Arthur Almond Flour
131 g granulated sugar
6 tbsp (43 g) confectioners' sugar, plus extra ( or so) for coating
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) table salt
2 large egg whites (≈60 g)
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) almond extract
1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond flour, sugars, and salt.
2. Add the egg whites and the almond extract, mixing until the dough becomes cohesive.
3. Form the dough into a disk, wrap it in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
4. Preheat the oven to 165 °C (fan 145 °C). Lightly grease a baking sheet, or line it with parchment.
5. Scoop the dough into 2.5 cm balls; a tsp cookie scoop works well here.
6. Put the extra confectioners' sugar into a shallow bowl. Drop the dough balls into the sugar as you go. Once about five or six are in the bowl, shake and toss the bowl to coat the balls with sugar.
7. Place the dough balls onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 4 cm apart. Gently press down on each ball to flatten just slightly.
8. Bake the cookies for 25 to 30 minutes, until they've cracked slightly and are a deep golden brown beneath the sugar, but are still slightly soft when pressed.
9. Remove the cookies from the oven, and allow them to cool for 5 minutes on the pan, then transfer them to a rack to cool completely.

en.t: 213 g all-purpose flour
5 tsp (25 ml) ground cinnamon
1 tsp (5 ml) ground cardamom
¼ tsp (1.2 ml) ground cloves
¼ tsp (1.5 g) baking soda
¼ tsp (1 g) baking powder
¼ tsp (1.5 g) salt
170 g turbinado sugar
8 tbsp (115 g) unsalted butter, cut into 1.5 cm pieces and chilled
1 large egg (≈50 g without shell)

1. Whisk flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, baking soda, baking powder, and salt together in bowl. Using pencil and ruler, draw 25 × 30 cm rectangle in center of each of 2 large sheets of parchment paper, crisscrossing lines at corners. (Use crisscrosses to help line up top and bottom sheets as dough is rolled.)

2. Process sugar in food processor for 30 seconds (some grains will be smaller than granulated sugar; others will be larger). Add butter and process until uniform mass forms and no large pieces of butter are visible, about 30 seconds, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Add egg and process until smooth and paste-like, about 10 seconds, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Add flour mixture and process until no dry flour remains but mixture remains crumbly, about 30 seconds, scraping down sides of bowl as needed.

3. Transfer dough to bowl and knead gently with spatula until uniform and smooth, about 10 seconds. Place 1 piece of parchment on counter with pencil side facing down (you should be able to see rectangle through paper). Place dough in center of marked rectangle and press into 15 × 23 cm rectangle. Place second sheet of parchment over dough, with pencil side facing up, so dough is in center of marked rectangle. Using pencil marks as guide, use rolling pin and bench scraper to shape dough into 25 × 30 cm rectangle of even thickness. Transfer dough with parchment to rimmed baking sheet. Refrigerate until dough is firm, at least 1½ hours (or freeze for 30 minutes). (Rolled dough can be wrapped in plastic wrap and refrigerated for up to 5 days.)

4. Adjust oven racks to upper-middle and lower-middle positions and heat oven to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). Line 2 rimless baking sheets with parchment. Transfer chilled dough to counter. Gently peel off top layer of parchment from dough. Using fluted pastry wheel (or sharp knife or pizza cutter) and ruler, trim off rounded edges of dough that extend over marked edges of 25 × 30 cm rectangle. Cut dough lengthwise into 8 equal strips about 3 cm wide. Cut each strip crosswise into 4 equal pieces about 7.5 cm long. Transfer cookies to prepared sheets, spacing them at least 1.5 cm apart. Bake until cookies are lightly and evenly browned, 30 to 32 minutes, switching and rotating sheets halfway through baking. Let cookies cool completely on sheets, about 20 minutes. (Cookies can be stored at room temperature for up to 3 weeks.)

Pečieme, kým nie sú zľahka a rovnomerne zhnednuté, 30 až 32 minút; v polovici pečenia plechy vymeníme a otočíme. Keksy necháme úplne vychladnúť na plechoch, asi 20 minút. (Pri izbovej teplote vydržia až 3 týždne.)

en.t: 1 vanilla bean, preferably Mexican
115 g all-purpose flour
85 g tapioca starch
55 g powdered sugar, plus more for dusting
1/4 tsp (1 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt
1/4 tsp (1 g) baking powder
115 g cold unsalted butter, cut into 0.5 cm pieces
2 large egg yolks (≈36 g), cold
1 Mexican vanilla bean (or the empty pod from the cookie dough), for the cajeta
965 g fresh goat's milk, preferably UHT, for the cajeta
170 g sugar, for the cajeta
5/8 tsp (3 g) baking soda, for the cajeta
1/8 tsp (0.4 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt, for the cajeta

1. Make the cajeta: Split the vanilla bean and scrape out the seeds (reserve them for another use). Combine the pod with the goat's milk, sugar, baking soda, and salt in a 4700 ml stainless-steel pot. Warm over medium heat, stirring occasionally with a heat-resistant spatula, until the sugar dissolves and the milk turns foamy and light, about 15 minutes.

2. Keep cooking at a gentle simmer, stirring and scraping the sides of the pot frequently (more often as it thickens), until the milk is thick, golden, and reduced to a thin, very jammy layer, about 45 minutes, and a spatula dragged across the bottom leaves a trail that stays open for 1 second. Remove from heat, discard the vanilla pod, and scrape the cajeta into a heat-resistant, wide-mouth glass jar. If there is less than 355 g, thin it with a little milk or water. (Cajeta can be refrigerated for up to 3 months.)

3. Split vanilla bean lengthwise with a paring knife and scrape out seeds with the flat of the blade; reserve empty pod for cajeta or another use. Combine vanilla seeds with flour, tapioca starch, powdered sugar, salt, baking powder, and butter in the bowl of a food processor. Pulse to form a fine and sandy meal, then add egg yolks and continue processing until the dough balls up around the blade. Divide in half and proceed to step 4, or wrap tightly in plastic and refrigerate up to 1 week.

4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Turn a portion of dough onto a powdered sugar–dusted surface and dust more powdered sugar on top. Roll dough until roughly 15 cm across, then dust with powdered sugar, flip upside down, and dust again. Continue rolling until dough is just shy of 0.5 cm thick. Slide a thin offset spatula under dough to loosen any places that might have stuck and cut dough into 5 cm rounds. Arrange cutouts on a parchment-lined aluminum half-sheet pan, leaving about 1.5 cm between cookies. Gather the scraps, briefly knead, and re-roll and cut as before. Repeat with remaining dough, for a total of 50 pieces. Bake until just beginning to brown around the edges, about 15 minutes, and cool to room temperature directly on sheet pan.

5. Transfer cajeta to a pastry bag fitted with a plain 0.5 cm tip. Flip half the cookies bottom side up and pipe a generous dollop of cajeta into the very center, up to 4 tsp (14 g), or less if you prefer. Alternatively, this can be done with a spoon. Top with remaining wafers and press gently to secure. Dust with powdered sugar and serve. In an airtight container, alfajores will keep 24 hours at room temperature or up to 1 week in the fridge.

1. Pripravíme cajetu: vanilkový struk rozrežeme a vyškrabeme semienka (odložíme si ich na iné použitie). Struk dáme spolu s mliekom, cukrom, sódou bikarbónou a soľou do 4,7-litrového hrnca z nehrdzavejúcej ocele. Zohrievame na strednom ohni a občas premiešame žiaruvzdornou stierkou, kým sa cukor nerozpustí a mlieko nezpenie a nezosvetlie, asi 15 minút.

2. Varíme ďalej pri miernom vare a často miešame a zoškrabujeme steny hrnca (čím hustejšia, tým častejšie), kým mlieko nie je husté, zlatisté a nezredukuje sa na tenkú vrstvu podobnú hustému džemu, asi 45 minút; stierka potiahnutá po dne zanechá stopu, ktorá zostane otvorená 1 sekundu. Odstavíme z ohňa, vanilkový struk vyberieme a cajetu preložíme do žiaruvzdorného skleneného pohára so širokým hrdlom. Ak je jej menej ako 355 g, zriedime ju trochou mlieka alebo vody. (Cajeta vydrží v chladničke až 3 mesiace.)

3. Vanilkový struk nožíkom pozdĺžne rozrežeme a plochou čepele vyškrabeme semienka; prázdny struk si odložíme na cajetu alebo iné použitie. Vanilkové semienka dáme do kuchynského robota spolu s múkou, tapiokovým škrobom, práškovým cukrom, soľou, kypriacim práškom a maslom. Pulzne premiešame na jemnú piesočnatú zmes, potom pridáme žĺtky a mixujeme, kým sa cesto nezhlukne okolo noža. Rozdelíme na polovice a pokračujeme 4. krokom, alebo pevne zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke až 1 týždeň.

4. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Časť cesta vyklopíme na plochu poprášenú práškovým cukrom a poprášime ho cukrom aj navrchu. Cesto vyvaľkáme na priemer asi 15 cm, potom ho poprášime práškovým cukrom, obrátime a znova poprášime. Vaľkáme ďalej, kým cesto nemá hrúbku tesne pod 0,5 cm. Pod cesto zasunieme tenkú zahnutú stierku, aby sme uvoľnili miesta, ktoré sa mohli prilepiť, a vykrojíme kolieska s priemerom 5 cm. Výkrojky poukladáme na hliníkový polovičný plech vystlaný papierom na pečenie, asi 1,5 cm od seba. Zvyšky spojíme, krátko premiesime, znova vyvaľkáme a vykrajujeme ako predtým. Zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom, spolu na 50 kúskov. Pečieme, kým okraje len nezačnú hnednúť, asi 15 minút, a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu priamo na plechu.

5. Cajetu preložíme do cukrárskeho vrecka s hladkou špičkou 0,5 cm. Polovicu keksov obrátime spodnou stranou nahor a do samého stredu každého nastriekame štedrú kôpku cajety, najviac 4 ČL (14 g), alebo menej, ak chceme. Môžeme na to použiť aj lyžičku. Prikryjeme zvyšnými keksmi a jemne pritlačíme. Poprášime práškovým cukrom a podávame. Vo vzduchotesnej nádobe vydržia alfajores 24 hodín pri izbovej teplote alebo až 1 týždeň v chladničke.

en.t: 3 large eggs (≈150 g without shell)

1. To make the cookies: In a large mixing bowl, beat together the eggs, brown sugar and salt. In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the flour, cinnamon and baking powder, then stir these dry ingredients into the egg mixture.
2. Fold in the vanilla and melted butter. Cook in a mini-pizzelle iron according to the manufacturer's directions.
3. To make the filling: Combine the water, sugar, butter and syrup in a medium-sized saucepan, stir over low heat until the sugar dissolves, then cover the pot and boil the mixture for 3 minutes.
4. Add the cinnamon, and continue to boil until the syrup reaches "soft ball stage" (110 °C to 115 °C on a candy or instant-read thermometer).
5. Remove the saucepan from the heat, and allow the mixture to cool for about 10 minutes.
6. Place one teaspoonful of filling (more for larger cookies) onto a cookie.
7. Top with a second cookie, pressing together to spread the filling. Be careful, as the sugar syrup will be very hot. If the syrup cools and becomes hard to spread, rewarm it slightly.
8. Store the cookies in a cool, dry place for 1 week, or freeze them for 1 month.
